services.name: Rental
services.desc: With an option for both smaller and larger groups, our vacation rentals feature a full bath and gorgeous river views! These rustic rentals offer comfortable options for those interested in enjoying extra amenities such as beds, separate restrooms, and heat/air conditioning while sleeping on the Potomac River. We have five beautiful rental homes to choose from - the Battlefields Inn which sleeps up to 10, the Brick House 1862 Inn which sleeps up to 12, the Adventure Inn which sleeps up to 14, the Down River Inn which sleeps up to 12, and the Country Roads Inn which sleeps up to 20. services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: The Harpers Ferry Campground offers a peaceful natural setting with comfortable accommodations by the Potomac River. We have options for RV sites, tent camping, glamping, and cabins to cater to different camper preferences. Experience the only waterfront RV park in Harpers Ferry! River Riders Campground offers a site to fit every need. Choose from riverfront full hook-up RV sites, trailside and hike-in island tent sites, and beautiful cliff top Riverview cabins. See a campground map here. Tent sites are meant only for tents. Popup campers or car camping will want an RV site or River View Trailside site if no water, electricity, or sewer is required.
